app_name: ADHD Habit Tracker, To Do List
title: Money grabbers - No real trial
body:
This app might be great for some people, but it wasn't what I was looking for, but they force you into their trial period to see how the app works and even though I canceled within the trial period they still charged me for a month usage. Tried getting a refund through Apple because I can't for the life of me understand how they can allow developers to charge people after they canceled, but they just say the purchase is not eligible for refund. 
SO BE WARNED! THEY CHARGE YOU FOR THE “free” TRIAL
author: ChrisMCloete
